name: Theater Bellevue, Leidsekade 90

attribution.title: Theater Bellevue, Leidsekade 90, Amsterdam: the yellow-brick theatre drum on the Leidsekade with its café wing and canal house
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the BAG footprint (CC0) with 3DBAG LoD2.2 heights and the 3DBAG shell for the fly tower, the west wing and the roofs (CC BY 4.0): the yellow-brick corner drum with its dark tile plinth, ribbon windows, fascia and coping running round the curve, the two-tone Theater Bellevue sign, the round window and the stage door, the cream café wing with its canopy and standing letters, and the brick canal house with white bands, a bay window and a balcony. Measured from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
